login.title: Login to your account
login.subtitle: Welcome back! Enter your details to log in

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Start your health companion in Bangla or English
signup.name: Name
signup.consent: I agree to the privacy policy and how my data is used

onboarding.consentBody: We only store what you log. You can delete everything anytime from Settings. This app is not a medical device.
onboarding.doctorFirst: Based on your answers, please talk to a doctor or registered dietitian before using calorie targets. You can still log food without targets.
onboarding.restrictedNote: We will keep guidance gentle — no deficit plans for now.

home.plateWhy: A balanced plate has vegetables, protein and grains.
home.overshoot: A bigger day than planned. Here is a gentle way to spread it
home.noMeals: Nothing logged yet. Start with breakfast.

log.title: Log food
log.ph: Type in Bangla, English or Banglish (e.g. bhat dal alu bhorta)
log.parsed: Meal items added — check portions before saving
log.offlineParsed: AI unavailable — using the offline food matches
log.noCandidates: No matching foods found. Try commas between items.
log.sharedPotHint: Enter the cooked pot weight and how many equal shares it serves.

plan.title: This week
plan.noPlan: Nothing to spread right now. Your week is on track.
plan.restricted: Maintenance guidance only — no deficit plans.
plan.doctorFirst: Please follow your clinician's advice. Logging still works.

coach.title: AI coach
coach.ph: Ask in Bangla, English or Banglish…
coach.suggest1: What can I eat for iftar?
coach.refusal: I can't help with that, but here is a safer idea
coach.lowConf: I could not find this in the guidelines. Please ask a dietitian.
coach.empty: Ask about food, portions or the plan. Answers cite the national guidelines.

activity.title: Today's movement
activity.onTrack: Good work — you are on track this week
activity.indoor: Air quality or heat suggests indoor options today.

settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteConfirm: Type DELETE to remove all data

safety.referral: Talk to a doctor or registered dietitian.
safety.notMedical: Not a medical device. No diagnosis.
